subject: Emergent AI - benchmark threshold handshake & run schedule
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hsu <sara@emergent.ai>; Tom Keller <tom.keller@emergent.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Emergent AI - benchmark threshold handshake & run schedule

Hi Sara / Tom,

Great to meet last week — thanks for the productive kickoff. As discussed, we9d like to lock in the load/latency acceptance run and the evidence sharing cadence so your engineering and SRE teams can plan around the windows. Proposed plan attached (emer-gate-loadplan-v1.csv). High-level: 

- Pre-run validation (dry run) — Mon 2028-06-26 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic)
- Full throughput run — Tue 2028-06-27 04:00-08:00 UTC (ramp to 4k rps, sustained 30m)
- Tail-latency sweeps — Wed 2028-06-28 03:00-06:00 UTC (99.9/99.99 targets)

Acceptance thresholds we9re targeting for the initial pass: 
- p50 token latency <= 12ms
- p95 token latency <= 45ms
- p99 token latency <= 120ms
- Sustained throughput: 4,000 requests/sec on the pinned Dedicated pool
- Error budget: <= 0.1% 5xxs during sustained windows

Deliverables from both sides: 
- Redwood: run scripts, KV-cache state used, raw telemetry (Prometheus + token-level traces), condensed results archive (JSON + CSV).
- Emergent: sample production prompt set (anonymized), expected request size distribution, and deliverable contact for the run-day.

Can you confirm the sample prompt-set link and the two engineers who will pair with our SRE on the run-day? Once we confirm, Monica will coordinate the concrete runbook and access.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the first pass done.

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rafael — this looks good. Quick notes: 

- We9re good on the prompt-set; I9ve uploaded an anonymized sample to the Drive folder you shared earlier (LINK: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEmergentBenchmark).
- On staffing: I can join the dry run and the tail-latency sweeps; Tom will be the primary eng lead for the throughput run. We9ll also loop in our infra lead (Marcus) if anything unusual pops up.
- One ask: can Redwood provide a short checklist for the pre-run seed data/state (KV cache warm-up) so we can replicate locally before the dry run?

If those are fine, Tom and I confirm the windows as proposed. We prefer results shared as both raw telemetry and a distilled CSV for our ops dashboard.

Sara

Subject: Internal: Emergent run roles & pre-run checklist

Monica / Jonas,

Per Sara9s reply, Emergent confirmed staffing. Action items for us before the dry run: 

1) Pre-run checklist (owner: Monica)
   - Share KV-cache seed script + expected warm-up token counts
   - Confirm pinned model/quantization profile and sequence length cap
   - Ensure dedicated pool has autoscaling off for the run; we9ll use fixed capacity to maintain deterministic results

2) Run-day telemetry (owner: Jonas)
   - Prometheus scrape interval 5s, token-level traces enabled, sampling rules applied to p99 traces
   - Export JSON per-run and compressed CSV summary

3) Coordinate access (owner: Monica)
   - Add emergent.ai service accounts to run cluster (temp IAM role)

I9ve attached the pre-run checklist draft to this thread in the Drive folder. Monica, can you update the checklist and drop anchors in the shared runbook doc? Jonas, please confirm the telemetry retention steps so we can compress and transfer artifacts within 24 hrs of completion.

Thanks,
Rafael

> Note: internal only reply — do not include Emergent on interim doc iterations until we have the final runbook.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>; Sara Hsu <sara@emergent.ai>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@emergent.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Emergent AI - benchmark threshold handshake & run schedule

Folks,

Run complete. Summary and artifacts attached. Highlights: 

- Throughput: achieved sustained 4,050 req/sec during the 30m steady window (4k goal met)
- Latency: p50=10.8ms, p95=38.9ms, p99=110.7ms (all within target)
- Errors: 0.04% 5xxs during the sustained window (below error budget)
- Notes: Observed a short (~45s) CPU hot-spot on node pool-3 at T+18m during ramp; autoscaling was disabled per runbook so we observed the raw degradation and recovered after ramp throttles.

Artifacts: run-results-20280625.zip (contains token-trace-samples.json, summary.csv, prometheus-scrape-20280625.tar.gz). I9ve pushed the archive to the shared Drive folder and updated the HubSpot deal with the pass/fail and artifacts link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4821.

Next steps: 
- Monica: please send the condensed CSV to Emergent (for their ops dashboard) and confirm any follow-ups on model-profile changes.
- Rafael: if Emergent wants a second pass with an alternate quantization profile, we can schedule for next week.

Thanks everyone — good run.

--
Jonas Weber
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
